text_block_list.text:
One day, I bring <chrname>
to the
infirmary for a checkup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh! A custo―I mean, a student! Hello!

Are you hurt? Sick? Stressed? Whatever
it is, I
treat it all!

Well, considering you're at the academy

infirmary, I'd say that makes me your
trusty
school nurse! Yup, just your
average school
employee!

Ahaha! Guess there's no fooling you. I
suppose I
should start by giving you my
name.
Ahem! Allow me to introduce myself!

I am the (likely) savior of all
Umamusume, the
(self-proclaimed)
legendary acupuncturist with
the magic
touch...

The one and only Сасами Ансиндзава!
See? No
worries! ☆
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: Gosh! You sure seem worried! ☆
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
No matter! No matter! We've made our

introductions, so lie down and let me
put these
needles to work!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
What? Where did that come from? What
are you
going to do to me?!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! No need to be scared! All I'm
going to do
is slip these extraordinary
needles precisely into
your chakra
points.
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
Then voilà, presto! Something
indescribable will
happen!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
And let me assure you, there's
absolutely nothing
sketchy about this at
all! It's never gone anything
less than
perfectly!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: ...For my master.
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава
choice_data_list: For your master?! What about for you?!

text_block_list.text:
Don't fret! This is my first time, so
technically, I've
never failed a patient
either!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
And it's not like I have no experience! I
spent ten
years under a legendary
master, fetching dri—I
mean, training!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: See? No worries! ☆
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава
choice_data_list: (We need to get outta here, stat!)

text_block_list.text:
There's no way we're doing this. I take

<chrname> and head for the
door,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: W-wait! Where are you going?!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
You're Дайва Скарлет, aren't you? The

Umamusume who'll never settle for less
than first
place? The future number one?
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
Have I heard of her? Of course I have!
I'm a big
fan!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why I'm here! To give
you my
support! Let me help you!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: Just give me a chance! Pleeease!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
What do we do, Тренер? She's definitely

suspicious, but...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Please! Pretty please with a carrot on
top! I'll even
let you choose which
chakra I activate!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: I'm sure I won't mess up!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: Well... pretty sure.
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: I mean, it's on the sure side! That's good, right? Anyway, don't get hung up on the details!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: Let's get to the good stuff! Which chakra should I activate? Do you want a boost to your abilities? Your health? Or maybe your charm?
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and tell me which chakra you
want me
to activate, then!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: I smell danger in the air, but I figure there might—and I emphasize might—be a chance of getting something special out of this treatment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What should we do?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

I see, I see. So you want me to activate
the
strength chakra?

text_block_list.text:

There's no
going back after!

text_block_list.text:

that
chakra! Ollie, ollie, oxen free!

text_block_list.text: Now, just relaaax... See? No worries! ☆

text_block_list.text: Aaand poke!
text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

text_block_list.text: Ouch!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

a
number one racer can really do!

text_block_list.name: Сасами Ансиндзава

genius!

unrecognizable!

deteriorates
